<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="kerapac-the-bound-solo-necromancy" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Kerapac, the Bound - Solo Necromancy</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/1fZdXd5U3v.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of Kerapac which can be seen here </nowiki><span><nowiki>#kerapac-hm-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki> and own BIS gear in Necromancy.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>It is </nowiki><strong><nowiki>required</nowiki></strong><nowiki> to have a Nodon dragonkin slayer task </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as the genocidal boost does work with Necromancy. You may also use the Premier Artefact </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/918517285176623104.png?v=1" alt="premierartefact" title="premierartefact" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to have a 10% chance to not decrease the slayer task count with each kill.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=QpaFNZ40x5eE0dExdBPR <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FQpaFNZ40x5eE0dExdBPR.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="additional-info"><nowiki>Additional Info</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 3%+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689503091539705870.png?v=1" alt="genocidal" title="genocidal" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Nodon dragonkin task required, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1" alt="flank4" title="flank4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> switch</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Drinking </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281882955787.png?v=1" alt="spiritualprayer" title="spiritualprayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> through the kill is required for this method to work, ideally 4-5</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There will be some RNG involved in this strategy due to low </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626412560395.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofful" title="scriptureofful" kind="icon" /><nowiki> proc rates on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> adrenaline gain during </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1" alt="timewarp" title="timewarp" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="pre-fight-wars-retreat"><ins><nowiki>Pre-fight</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Wars Retreat)</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Get 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at wars, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/656844963522281473.png?v=1" alt="dummy" title="dummy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and 4+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>Echo 2: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → basic for 100 adren if needed, otherwise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1" alt="timewarp" title="timewarp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + 1t → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1" alt="livingdeath" title="livingdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to echo 3</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Echo 3: may need more abilities if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> does not bounce</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809140476031057.png?v=1" alt="soulsap" title="soulsap" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to kerapac</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Kerapac: use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1" alt="veng" title="veng" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="rod" title="rod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to maximise </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809168368148490.png?v=1" alt="splitsoul" title="splitsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + equip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159462825984.png?v=1" alt="rod" title="rod" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="notes"><nowiki>Notes</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-1_1"><nowiki>Phase 1</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If you </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1" alt="relentless5" title="relentless5" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> you can skip </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ see !0tick on how to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417538045317121.png?v=1" alt="roarofawakening" title="roarofawakening" kind="icon" /><nowiki> without losing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1" alt="lifetransfer" title="lifetransfer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is available, use it while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1" alt="kerapac" title="kerapac" kind="icon" /><nowiki> immune and get 100 adren for instant </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1" alt="timewarp" title="timewarp" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ On kills with 0 jumps, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809128136388819.png?v=1" alt="lifetransfer" title="lifetransfer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will not be up. if you have adren from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712244800920748092.png?v=1" alt="relentless5" title="relentless5" kind="icon" /><nowiki> procs you can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> while </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/875443920673337344.png?v=1" alt="kerapac" title="kerapac" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is immune for extra damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-2_1"><nowiki>Phase 2</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can opt to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073088296157185.png?v=1" alt="flank4" title="flank4" kind="icon" /><nowiki>; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809142376058910.png?v=1" alt="soulstrike" title="soulstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after step under for some consistent damage, but it is not required.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ If no </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> adren, end </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1" alt="timewarp" title="timewarp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809194423160883.png?v=1" alt="commandskeleton" title="commandskeleton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/870328868815396914.png?v=1" alt="timewarp" title="timewarp" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ends</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-3_1"><nowiki>Phase 3</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Try not to skip jump p3 as you cant </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if Kerapac is not in attack range</nowiki></p>
